quest.title: Blazin' Trails
quest.description: Plants and instruments, melodies and memories, old acquaintances and her hometown... All of them constitute a crucial part of Xinyan's music. There must be some reason that her mirage has shown up on this special island.
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2

talks.objective: Clear the water veins on the island
Clear the water veins on the island

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We've done everything we can, but how do we deal with the last two mountains?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Let's stick to it. There's gotta be a way.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: After taking a closer look, it seems to me that most of the island mountains contain water veins and plants in their interior. Those together form a system that connects the mountains with one another.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: However, now that much of the mountains have collapsed, the connection of plants and water veins is blocked.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: If we can dredge all the blockages, we will be able to connect the islands to form the giant instrument described in Albedo's notes, and play music using the islands themselves.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Yep, for me to reach my goal, we gotta do this... But first, I'd like to consult the flower. It should know what to do.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Some of the plants and water veins on the island mountains have been lost. Do you happen to know another way to dredge the blockages?

dialogues.speaker: Blazing Heart
dialogues.text: I know someone who can help you with that. Go ask my companion, Frozen Soul, who lives upstairs.

dialogues.speaker: Frozen Soul
dialogues.text: Who are you, and what brings you to me?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Nice to meet you. We were wondering if we could use your power to dredge the mountains on the island.

dialogues.speaker: Frozen Soul
dialogues.text: Mountains? Oh, I see... you want to become great musicians too, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh? Is that what this is about?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Correct.

dialogues.speaker: Frozen Soul
dialogues.text: In that case, we seek the same thing. Despite my frailty, I feel obligated to share some of my power with you.

dialogues.speaker: Frozen Soul
dialogues.text: Plant my petal at the ending point of the intersection of melodies, and what had once sunk into the earth will re-emerge with the music. As long as there is music, life will continue to flourish in this world.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: ...Thank you.

talks.objective: Clear the water veins on the island
Clear the water veins on the island
Inform Frozen Soul of the result

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Can you feel anything, now that we've planted the petal?

dialogues.speaker: Frozen Soul
dialogues.text: Yes, I can feel it. The sun is shining brightly, the sea gleams like a gemstone, the waves lap the milky-white beaches, and the grains of sand are pulled into the sea, then pushed back ashore...

dialogues.speaker: Frozen Soul
dialogues.text: ...the seabirds are landing on the rocks, pecking gently and making rhythmic sounds. ♪ dum-dum, dum-dum ♪...

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: It's music.

dialogues.speaker: Frozen Soul
dialogues.text: This is indeed music. In fact, this whole island is a giant musical instrument. Since you are a musician, you should be able to understand the meaning behind its original creation.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Making music with the tides, waves, and sea breeze as your instruments is the most romantic thing in the world.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Let's go, everyone. It's time for my performance.

talks.objective: Go to the hill where the wind blows

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Finally, the time has come.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Everyone, I once made a wish to perform with someone no one could have expected. And today, on this island, I've found my answer.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: No one knows the name or appearance of the man who transformed this island into a giant musical instrument so many years ago, but he is unquestionably one of Teyvat's greatest musicians.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: I never imagined I'd be able to see such an instrument, and I never imagined we'd be able to play it during a high tide.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you going to play some rock 'n' roll?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: No.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Music is the gift one gives to their kindred spirit, so... I'll play something that makes for a better duet with the original musician.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: No rock music for today. Instead, I'm gonna show you something new!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: ...Phew.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: How was it? Not bad, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Quite impressive.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I've never heard a duet like that before. It was very interesting.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And so elegant as well! Paimon's not sure how best to put it... But it was just super unique.

choices.text: A performance with a lot of personality.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: And now I can say my wish has come true.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Is there anything else you'd like to do?

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: No, in fact, I reckon I'll get a good night's sleep tonight.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Does this mean everyone is free for the time being? If so, I have a suggestion.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: I'd like to return to the Fatui camp, and see what's going on there.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Oh? So you've discovered the Fatui camp as well.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Wait, you know about it too?

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Of course, I'm a genius astrologist. Didn't I mention that my scryglass has recovered a little? I can sense what's going on here through divination.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Uh, I didn't know the Fatui were here too.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Indeed. I also informed Fischl of this when we parted ways today. If she runs into them, she'll stay hidden and out of danger.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: I see, then perhaps we should tell everyone what we know.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You tell everyone about the Fatui camp and the strange machine you found on the day you arrived...

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: A strange machine, and delirious Fatui...? Are you suggesting these are connected to the mirage?

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: I can't say I'm certain, but I don't believe they are completely unrelated.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Fair enough. Let's go check out the camp.

choices.text: A performance with a lot of charm.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's strange that on our way here, we've only run into local monsters, and no Fatui.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: How bizarre... there are still signs of the camp, and the machine is still here, but all the people have vanished.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (This machine must have something to do with the mirages. Sure, it's broken, but maybe that itself is the cause.)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (...But if the machine can cause people to hallucinate, why did they vanish? Is there anything else going on?)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Did they disappear, or are they hiding from us?)

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: I give up — I'm just going to divine the answer.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: What's this...? Some kind of energy flow?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Sorry, everyone, I can't seem to find any trace of the Fatui. My scryglass has gotten hazy again, but this time, I can sense some sort of energy converging and taking physical form.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: The destination is... the island over there.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Whose mirage will it be this time?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Hmm... let's head over and have a look. Maybe we'll be able to find something there.

talks.objective: Go to the island that Mona mentioned

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Here we are.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Huh? Fischl?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's really her! Hey, Fischl—!

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: ...Hmph, my imprudent retainers, you've finally arrived.

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: O—Oh my, long time no see!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: It hasn't been that long, has it?

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: Ahem... Mein Fräulein and I sensed a peculiar aura, and came here ahead of time to reunite with everyone. We weren't expecting you... Well, what I mean to say is, you arrived sooner than we expected.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is it just Paimon, or does Oz seem nervous?

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: The advent of the Immernachtreich is imminent, and I still need to prepare for the consecration.

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: Mein Fräulein, are you sure you—

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: I am quite capable of acting on my own, Oz. If you're weary of the encroaching darkness of the night, you're quite welcome to return to the blinding brightness of the day.

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: Please, mein Fräulein, do not say such things. I am your loyal attendant, your eyes, and I will never leave your side.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: ...Stop staring at me like that! A—Anyway, the time of explanation... is not yet upon us, hmph!

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: Oh, mein Fräulein!

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: I do apologize, everyone. Mein Fräulein is having a rough day — please do not take it to heart. I must also excuse myself now.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: ...Huh, still no improvement in her mood, even after all this time away from the group.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: As soon as I saw Fischl, I realized that the mirage that's about to take shape here must have something to do with her.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Yes. I, at least, felt a peculiar sense of familiarity when I approached my mirage.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Me too. Even though it didn't really make sense, I just had a feeling that something exciting was gonna happen.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Exactly, if Fischl and Oz can also sense something, then our suspicions are likely to be right on the Mora... Fischl's probably agitated because she doesn't want to confront her mirage.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How come?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Maybe her mirage conceals some secrets that she doesn't want anyone to know about.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Let's all take a rest here for now. When the mirage appears, we will get to the bottom of this mystery.
